title: Open Practices via ODDPub
description: Open data and code detection via ODDPub (https://github.com/quest-bih/oddpub). This describes individual papers -- papers may have more than one open data or code source, which are described together here with arrays for open_data_category and by combining sentences for das/cas/open_data_statements/open_code_statements.

article.description: A reference to the paper being processed

open_data_category.description: What type of data are available

enum: supplementary raw/full data with specific file format

is_reuse.description: Is data reused from another source

is_code_supplement.description: Is there code in supplemental materials

is_code_reuse.description: Is code reused from another source

is_open_data_das.description: Is there a data availability statement indicating open data

is_open_code_cas.description: Is there a code availability statement indicating open code

open_data_statements.description: Any statements about open data in the full tet

open_code_statements.description: Any statements about open code in the full text
